evidence.line: them-1: Ты просто главное не забудь, что типа, Рустам, ну у меня какая-то получается.
evidence.why: them-1 tells Mikhail what to say to him if the task stalls: 'Rustam, it is not working for me'
continues the quoted request: Rustam is the one who would take the task over, i.e. the speaker

evidence.line: them-1: Ну, я себе какую-то напоминалку сделаю, буду записи вести, буду прям дрючить.
evidence.why: the speaker is the one controlling delegation, consistent with being the addressee 'Рустам'

topics_per_label.them-1: delegation and control, DRI (directly responsible individual) explained, made Sergei the DRI, proactive technical tasks

notes: One remote voice, no echo. The name comes from the speaker referring to himself in quoted speech ('just tell me: Rustam, it is not working, take it over'), not from a greeting, hence medium. 'Серега, возьмешь' (13) is him quoting his own words to Sergei, so he is not Sergei.
